# Coverage audit of the 102826 deck (2026-10-23)

**The question (the user, 2026-10-23):** does the deck cover every experiment, claim and conclusion, and every proposal and idea from the user's side?

**The answer: yes, 333 of 333 items.** This file is generated by `coverage_check.py` from the built `slides.html`. Each item below is one entry of the two inventories made on 2026-10-23:

- every experiment stage, every cross-topic conclusion and every withdrawn or corrected claim, read from the topic READMEs, `harness_eval/REPORT.md` and `MODELS.md`, `method_develop/README.md`, the conclusion notes of 091626, 092326 and 102126 and the summary slides of all six earlier decks;
- every idea, question and decision of the user's, read from the plan files, the session records of Oct 7 to 23 and the topic READMEs that mark a question as the user's, plus the 10-13 brainstorm, the accepted assistant proposals, the earlier unattributed questions and the numbered next steps 1-24.

For each item the script checks that its phrases appear in the visible text of the slide(s) it is mapped to (SVG labels included, hover text excluded). Slides: 1-3 are the main slides; B1-B11 are the backups (B1-B5 every experiment, B6 conclusions, B7 corrections, B8 your questions and decisions, B9 your brainstorm and the Oct 7 methods, B10 next steps, B11 prior work). The private Artifact is https://claude.ai/artifact/EY2YeaAHZ8kVW2C24z8UPc.

Withdrawn or corrected claims are covered as corrections (B7 and B6's last column), never as findings.
